name: FormBench savings
description: What you would save by switching from the paid apps the Form family is instead of: slide through the apps, set the years, read the monthly, yearly and total savings, with supporting FormAI as a separate optional suggestion.

lead1.label: Heading, first line
lead1.default: What would you stop paying for?

lede.label: Intro
lede.default: Every Form app stands in for a paid app. Slide through the apps a creative usually switches from, in the order they usually switch, and see what you would no longer pay.

supportHeading.label: Support heading
supportHeading.default: Support FormAI, if the savings were worth it

children.name: Fine print
children.text: Savings are an estimate of what you stop paying, not a quote. Yearly is monthly times 12. Free tools, and tools bundled with another, such as Adobe Media Encoder, count as 0 and are not listed. Framer or Webflow is counted at Framer Basic, the lower of the two. Substance 3D Painter is its own plan, so it sits outside the Adobe single-app count and the Creative Cloud Pro cap. The Creative Cloud Pro price comes from
